metadata.case_name: YIP WAN CHUN v. JIM HON TAK AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: a hawker helping her husband at their stall in the Heung Che Street Market in Tsuen Wan
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: assist around the stall by tying up vegetables for customers, tidying up and indeed looking after the stall while her husband is away during the quieter hours in the morning

injuries.description: a cut about 10 cm. long which extended from the left temple down beside and under the left eye (stitched); faint scar
injuries.body_part: left temple / left side of face
source: she received a cut about 10 cm. long which extended from the left temple down beside and under the left eye. This was stitched after the Plaintiff was taken to hospital where she remained for 3 weeks. It is now faintly visible.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of eyelid or periocular area

injuries.description: fracture of the left temporal bone
source: the left temporal bone was fractured as a result of the impact. The fracture would have severed the cochlear nerve which would produce immediate and complete deafness in the left ear.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other specified skull or facial bones

injuries.description: severe sensorineural deafness in both ears with total deafness in the left ear and a loss of up to 95 out of a possible 100 decibels in the speech frequencies in the right ear
source: the Plaintiff is suffering from severe sensori neural deafness in both ears with total deafness in the left ear and a loss of up to 95 out of a possible 100 decibels in the speech frequencies in the right ear.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

injuries.description: fracture of the left collarbone (clavicle) with non-union / fibrous union and overriding of some half an inch
source: the Plaintiff's left collarbone was fractured. The Plaintiff is now left with a loss of some 20o of abduction, that is, she is unable to raise her arm the last 20o into a vertical position, and some 10o out of a normal 80o of external rotation, external rotation being demonstrated by putting one's hand to the back of one's head in order to comb one's hair. These restrictions are because the collarbone has not united in the normal manner. There is an overriding of some half an inch by the bones themselves, while the fracture is united by fibrous tissue.

manifestations.description: faintly visible scar beside and under the left eye
loss of some 20 degrees of abduction of left arm
loss of some 10 degrees of external rotation of left arm
severe sensorineural deafness with total deafness in the left ear and up to 95 dB loss in speech frequencies in the right ear

losses.description: faint scar beside and under the left eye causing the Plaintiff some concern
loss of range of motion of left shoulder (20 degrees abduction and 10 degrees reduced external rotation) from fracture of left collarbone
severe sensorineural deafness in both ears with total deafness in the left ear and profound loss in the right ear, causing inability to communicate normally
Plaintiff is cut off socially and suffers social embarrassment and inability to communicate with customers and neighbours because of hearing loss
unable properly to communicate with her children
will not be able to assist her husband as fully as before the accident at their stall (reduced earning capacity)

comparable_cases.case_name: Ashley Middleton & Anr v Cheng King-Ying & Anr
comparable_cases.injury_description: 45% hearing loss in the left ear
